responsibility: Coordinates intrinsic code generation for `rust-intrinsic` and `llvm.*` calls in `rustc_codegen_cranelift`. This file defines the shared argument decoding, SIMD lane traversal helpers, validation/reporting utilities, and the main intrinsic dispatcher that either lowers supported intrinsics directly, delegates LLVM and SIMD subsets to sibling modules, or falls back to normal item codegen when an intrinsic is not required to be overridden.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is the dispatcher for special builtins that bypass ordinary item codegen: it decodes intrinsic arguments, validates types, performs SIMD lane-wise helpers, routes `llvm.*` families to submodules, and falls back only when an intrinsic need not be overridden. Its scope is per-intrinsic lowering, not ABI-wide call setup, debuginfo ownership, driver predeclaration/profiling, or optimization module declaration.
